nodes.name: EntityHarvester.java
nodes.summary: Harvester vehicle entity implementing resource collection, delivery, pip display, order resolution, and rendering for harvester units.
nodes.languageNotes: Java entity with extensive state management for resource harvesting workflow.

nodes.name: EntityHarvester
nodes.summary: Harvester entity with resource capacity tracking, sprite rendering, proc linking, order targeting, and resource extraction lifecycle.

nodes.name: EntityHarvester
nodes.summary: Constructor loading textures, setting HP/max HP, creating order targeters, and configuring build requirements.

nodes.name: updateEntity
nodes.summary: Updates harvester state including harvesting/dropping frame animation and super.updateEntity delegation.

nodes.name: renderEntity
nodes.summary: Renders the harvester with rotation-aware texture sub-images and pip overlay for resource visualization.

nodes.name: select
nodes.summary: Marks the harvester as selected with visual highlight.

nodes.name: cancelSelect
nodes.summary: Removes selection highlight from the harvester.

nodes.name: isSelected
nodes.summary: Returns the selection state of the harvester.

nodes.name: shouldRenderedInPass
nodes.summary: Determines which render pass this entity belongs to.

nodes.name: getMoveSpeed
nodes.summary: Returns the harvester movement speed.

nodes.name: getTextureX
nodes.summary: Returns the X position for texture rendering.

nodes.name: getTextureY
nodes.summary: Returns the Y position for texture rendering.

nodes.name: getRevealingRange
nodes.summary: Returns the shroud revealing range.

nodes.name: findPathFromTo
nodes.summary: Delegates pathfinding to the vehicle pathfinder via the world.

nodes.name: getMinimumEnoughRange
nodes.summary: Returns minimum range threshold for movement.

nodes.name: getWaitAverageTime
nodes.summary: Returns average wait time for movement blocking.

nodes.name: getWaitSpreadTime
nodes.summary: Returns wait time spread for movement blocking.

nodes.name: acceptResource
nodes.summary: Adds a resource type to the harvester's contents map, incrementing quantity or setting to 1.

nodes.name: isFull
nodes.summary: Checks if the harvester has reached its total capacity.

nodes.name: isEmpty
nodes.summary: Checks if the harvester has no resources.

nodes.name: getCapacity
nodes.summary: Calculates total resource capacity by summing all resource quantities in contents.

nodes.name: clearContents
nodes.summary: Delivers each resource type to the linked proc and clears the harvester's contents.

nodes.name: getPipCount
nodes.summary: Returns the number of pip indicators to display.

nodes.name: getPipColorAt
nodes.summary: Returns the pip color at a given index based on resource contents, cycling through resource types.

nodes.name: issueOrder
nodes.summary: Issues harvest or deliver orders based on the order targeter string.

nodes.name: resolveOrder
nodes.summary: Resolves incoming orders: harvest, return, stop, and move, queuing appropriate activities.

nodes.name: findClosestProc
nodes.summary: Scans world entities for the closest EntityProc (refinery) to the harvester.

nodes.name: getBuildingCost
nodes.summary: Returns the building cost of the harvester.
